items.source: Returns ProxyTransactionManagementConfiguration or AspectJ(Jta)TransactionManagementConfiguration for PROXY and ASPECTJ values of EnableTransactionManagement.mode(), respectively.
items.translation: 返回 `ProxyTransactionManagementConfiguration` 或 `AspectJ(Jta)TransactionManagementConfiguration`，分别对应 `EnableTransactionManagement.mode()` 的 `PROXY` 和 `ASPECTJ` 值。

items.source: selectImports in class AdviceModeImportSelector<EnableTransactionManagement>
items.translation: selectImports 类中的 AdviceModeImportSelector<EnableTransactionManagement>

items.source: Selects which implementation of AbstractTransactionManagementConfiguration should be used based on the value of EnableTransactionManagement.mode() on the importing @Configuration class.
items.translation: 选择要使用的AbstractTransactionManagementConfiguration实现，具体取决于导入的@Configuration类上EnableTransactionManagement.mode()的值。

items.source: adviceMode - the value of the advice mode attribute for the annotation specified via generics.
items.translation: `adviceMode` - 通过泛型指定的注解的advice mode 属性的值。

items.source: array containing classes to import (empty array if none; null if the given AdviceMode is unknown)
items.translation: 包含要导入的类的数组（如果没有则为空数组；如果给定的 `AdviceMode` 未知则为`null`）
